title: Amazon is investing $1B in a hot new tech role. Here's what the job entails.
excerpt: The role of the forward-deployed engineer is quickly becoming the hottest job in tech as demand soars with investments from companies like Amazon.
content_html:
By Katherine Li

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

As AI reshapes the tech workforce, Amazon is making a billion-dollar bet that one engineering job is only becoming more valuable.

The company said on Thursday in its second-quarter earnings report that it will invest $1 billion to build AWS Forward Deployed Engineering, a new team of AI engineers who will work directly inside customer organizations to build and launch agentic AI systems in "days rather than months."

Early customers include the Allen Institute, Cox Automotive, the NBA, the NFL, Ricoh, and Southwest Airlines, Amazon said.

The announcement underscores the rapid rise of the forward-deployed engineer, or FDE, a once-niche role that has become one of the hottest jobs in enterprise AI.

"Forward-deployed engineers, or roles that do the equivalent motion, are about to become one of the most in-demand jobs in tech. And one of the most important functions for AI rollouts," Box CEO Aaron Levie wrote on LinkedIn in May.

The hiring boom backs that up. Business Insider previously reported that job postings for forward-deployed engineers have surged since January 2025, according to Indeed data. Companies including Anthropic, OpenAI, Palantir, Stripe, and Google Cloud have all expanded hiring for the role.

The position, popularized by Palantir, embeds engineers directly with customers to build software tailored to their needs. It sits somewhere between software engineering, consulting, and product deployment.

Kanav Bhatnagar, a senior forward-deployed engineer at Rippling, previously told Business Insider that instead of building products from afar, he works directly with clients and learns how their businesses operate before tailoring AI systems to fit their workflows.

"My primary job is listening to customers and understanding their problems," Bhatnagar said, adding that he spends roughly equal time coding and collaborating with product teams.

That hands-on approach has become increasingly important as companies race to deploy generative AI but struggle to move projects from pilot programs into production.

OpenAI created its own forward-deployed engineering team after realizing customers needed more than access to models. Speaking at the Fortune Brainstorm AI conference last year, international managing director Oliver Jay said the company hired engineers to work directly on customers' largest AI deployments because it was "a really specific way to advance the acceleration of advanced AI into scale production cases."

Job postings on Indeed, analyzed by Business Insider, show that forward-deployed engineering roles typically pay between about $170,000 and $200,000. OpenAI's own job listings, which Business Insider previously reviewed in November 2025, advertise US-based forward-deployed engineering positions paying up to $345,000 in base salary, excluding equity.

content_html_zh:
作者：Katherine Li 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

随着人工智能重塑科技劳动力，亚马逊下了十亿美元的赌注，认为一项工程工作只会变得更有价值。

该公司周四在第二季度收益报告中表示，将投资 10 亿美元建立 AWS 前向部署工程，这是一个新的人工智能工程师团队，他们将直接在客户组织内部工作，在“几天而不是几个月”内构建和启动代理人工智能系统。

亚马逊表示，早期客户包括艾伦研究所、考克斯汽车公司、NBA、NFL、理光和西南航空。

这一公告突显了前沿部署工程师（FDE）的迅速崛起，这个曾经是小众的角色现已成为企业人工智能领域最热门的职位之一。

“前沿部署的工程师或执行同等动作的角色即将成为科技领域最受欢迎的工作之一。 这是人工智能推广最重要的功能之一。”Box 首席执行官 Aaron Levie 五月份在 LinkedIn 上写道。

招聘热潮证明了这一点。 Business Insider 此前报道称，根据 Indeed 数据，自 2025 年 1 月以来，前沿部署工程师的职位招聘数量激增。 Anthropic、OpenAI、Palantir、Stripe 和 Google Cloud 等公司都扩大了该职位的招聘规模。

该职位由 Palantir 推广，让工程师直接与客户接触，根据他们的需求构建软件。 它介于软件工程、咨询和产品部署之间。

Rippling 的高级前沿部署工程师 Kanav Bhatnagar 此前告诉《商业内幕》，他不是从远处构建产品，而是直接与客户合作，了解他们的业务运作方式，然后定制人工智能系统以适应他们的工作流程。

“我的主要工作是倾听客户的意见并了解他们的问题，”巴特纳加尔说，并补充说他花在编码和与产品团队协作上的时间大致相同。

随着公司竞相部署生成式人工智能，但又难以将项目从试点项目转化为生产，这种实践方法变得越来越重要。

在意识到客户需要的不仅仅是访问模型后，OpenAI 创建了自己的前沿部署工程团队。 国际董事总经理奥利弗·杰伊 (Oliver Jay) 在去年的《财富》人工智能头脑风暴会议上发表讲话时表示，该公司聘请工程师直接从事客户最大的人工智能部署工作，因为这是“将先进人工智能加速推进规模生产案例的真正具体方式”。

Business Insider 分析的 Indeed 上的招聘信息显示，前沿部署的工程职位的薪资通常在 17 万至 20 万美元之间。 《商业内幕》此前于 2025 年 11 月审查过 OpenAI 自己的职位清单，广告中的美国前沿部署工程职位的基本工资高达 345,000 美元（不包括股权）。
